# Calculator App

A beautiful, fully functional calculator app built with React and Vite.

## Features

- ✨ Clean, modern iOS-style design
- ➕ Basic arithmetic operations (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division)
- 🔢 Decimal number support
- ➖ Toggle positive/negative numbers
- 📊 Percentage calculations
- 🧹 Clear/All Clear functionality
- 📱 Responsive design

## Installation

```bash
npm install
```

## Development

```bash
npm run dev
```

The app will be available at `http://localhost:5173`

## Build

```bash
npm run build
```

## Usage

- Click number buttons to input digits
- Click operator buttons (+, −, ×, ÷) to perform operations
- Click = to calculate the result
- Click C/AC to clear the display
- Click ± to toggle positive/negative
- Click % to convert to percentage
- Click ● for decimal point

Enjoy calculating!
